strings.name: Song Kang-ho
strings.summary: Song moved from theater into film, using comic timing, physical detail and emotional shifts to portray ordinary people’s contradictions. Joint Security Area, Memories of Murder, The Host and Parasite span major phases of Korean cinema. His role in Broker earned him Cannes’ acting prize; Uncle Samsik and BEEF extended his work into series.
